paginas.texto: Erik built a weather machine from an umbrella, two spoons and a bicycle bell.
'It can tell us if it is going to rain,' he said. Nobody believed him. Not even Luna.
On Monday the machine rang the bell. It was sunny all day.
On Tuesday the machine said nothing. It rained for six hours.
'Your machine is wrong every time,' said Sofia. 'That is very difficult too,' said Erik.
On Saturday the Club wanted a picnic. Erik looked at his machine and said: 'Take your coats.'
The sky was blue. Everybody laughed at Erik and left their coats at home.
At four o'clock it snowed. It never snows in September. Everybody ran home very fast.
Erik said nothing. He just rang his little bell, once, and put the machine back in his bag.
